name: Gmail
detail: Inbox, reply drafts, and sends you approve. One Google sign-in. Mail never leaves this computer for a Surf server.

name: Google Calendar
detail: Read your calendar, find conflicts, and create events after you approve.

name: Google Drive
detail: Search files you can already open. Creating or deleting a file waits for approval.

name: Outlook
detail: Mail and calendar through Microsoft Graph, with the same approval rules as Gmail.

name: Slack
detail: Read channels you are in. Posting uses your user token and waits for approval.

name: Alarms
detail: Local reminders through operating-system notifications. Works offline.

name: Files
detail: Folders you pick. Reads are automatic. Writes wait for a diff you approve.
